description: Create an empty playlist. is_public false keeps it visible to the owner only. site_section true shows it on the author's site as its own row. Add videos and streams with add_item_to_playlist.

site_order.description: Row position on the site, smallest first; null for none

site_section.description: Own row (section) on the author's site; a row is public.

name: create_playlist
title: Create a playlist
